title: 教程与新手引导不足
description: 教程提供的免费许可证持续时间过短，新手难以完成引导任务。
evidence: That "free" "tutorial" license doesn't last long. You got about an hour or two (normally the minimum duration sold is 24h), and that, considering someone who is completely new to the game, is not enough.
